author: Totally Not Mark
description:
BUY CHEEKY! -- http://usecheeky.com/NOTMARK 

For the first time in 18 years I have decided to return to one of my favourite childhood shows, Avatar the Last Airbender. I was very excited to get back into the mix with Aang, Katara, Sokka and Zuko again, but what awaited me was not what I expected. It seems that watching this masterpiece as an adult is an entirely new experience.

MUSIC COVERS USED:

Azula's Theme (Zhao Shen Music)
Avatar's Theme (Mofjell)
Zuko's Beach Flashback (Film Score and More)
The Seventh Chakra (Oh Boy Yeah)
Avatar TLA Credits (Dominik Pokorny)
title: Watching Avatar as an ADULT: Book Two (TOPH HYPE!!!)
